basics.name: Martin Birkenbaum
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying scalable, event-driven backend systems and microservices. Proven ability to architect personalized customer experiences, integrate AI/ML models, and drive operational excellence through GitOps-driven automation. Passionate about technical leadership, developer toolchains, and delivering high-quality, impactful solutions.

work.name: Initech Corporation
work.summary: Led architecture and development of high-throughput microservices and GitOps-driven infrastructure pipelines.
highlights: Designed and implemented Python-based high-throughput event-driven microservices processing 10M+ daily events, enabling real-time personalization and dynamic customer experiences.
Standardized containerized deployments utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, and GitOps workflows, ensuring scalable and reliable infrastructure for critical services.
Mentored 6 junior/mid-level engineers, fostering technical growth and setting high engineering standards for code quality and testing.
Developed custom internal toolchains that reduced CI pipeline execution times by 40%, improving developer velocity and operational efficiency.

work.name: Hooli Inc.
work.summary: Backend engineer focused on building RESTful APIs, developer tooling, and automated deployment integrations.
highlights: Developed robust REST APIs in Python/Django and TypeScript/Node.js, powering key backend functionalities for user-facing applications.
Integrated third-party APIs and automated webhook processors for external developer platforms, facilitating ingestion of diverse data signals.
Implemented a suite of unit and integration tests raising coverage from 60% to 92%, significantly improving system reliability and code quality.
